_approach: Industrial techno template (Attack's dissection): 909 kick 4/4, a noise-synth snare on 2 and 4, offbeat hats, a shaker on every second offbeat, a bitcrushed low tom ducked wherever it overlaps kick or hat, and a metallic clank (cowbell slot) as found-sound accent. Reference: I Hate Models 'Daydream', Dax J, 999999999 'No Sleep'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
